statement: In 3 of 5 books a toy or animal companion is drawn mirroring the protagonist's feeling (Jojo the monkey, Teddy, the dog) while saying nothing in the text.

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books (Book Dash, South Africa, 2021-2024)

magicpaper.current: catalog companions speak and act in text
magicpaper.suggested: Hypothesis: a companion can amplify feeling silently, through the picture; relevant to companion illustration briefs.
magicpaper.note: Companions as emotional amplifiers, not protagonists.
